title: 2014 HMMT February Geometry Problem 8
statement: Let \(A B C\) be a triangle with sides \(A B=6, B C=10\), and \(C A=8\). Let \(M\) and \(N\) be the midpoints of \(B A\) and \(B C\), respectively. Choose the point \(Y\) on ray \(C M\) so that the circumcircle of triangle \(A M Y\) is tangent to \(A N\). Find the area of triangle \(N A Y\).
